subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on September 15, 2022, at 11:00 AM. Your seat is reserved in Economy Class, and your booking reference number is XYZ123. Please check-in online 24 hours before departure. If you have any special requests or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, Flight Booking Team
